description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - fresh pick: a guided fruit-picking checklist for people who cannot tell ripe from raw - pick a fruit, photograph the one in your hand (record only), then walk the four checks an experienced shopper does (look, tap, smell, squeeze) and report what YOU observe; the agent scores your observations, gives a PICK IT / OK / SKIP IT verdict with the weakest check named, and can score a second candidate to compare the two; the agent never sees, smells or feels the fruit
name: fresh-pick
